items.name: Apple Almond Cinnamon Smoothie
steps: Wash and prepare the chopped apple and soaked almonds.
Place the prepared ingredients in a blender with the unsweetened almond milk and water.
Blend until completely smooth, pausing to scrape down the sides.
Add the cinnamon and blend briefly again.
Serve immediately at cool room temperature without ice.
items.guidance: Apple Almond Cinnamon Smoothie is a freshly blended drink served without ice. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Turmeric Almond-Milk Warmer
steps: Pour the unsweetened almond milk into a small heavy pan and warm it slowly.
Add the turmeric and cinnamon and black pepper and keep the heat low.
Simmer gently for five minutes, stirring so the liquid does not catch.
Remove from the heat and stir in the rock sugar.
Serve warm in small cups.

steps: Pour the unsweetened almond milk into a small heavy pan and warm it slowly.
Add the fennel seeds and green cardamom and keep the heat low.
Simmer gently for five minutes, stirring so the liquid does not catch.
Remove from the heat and stir in the rock sugar.
Serve warm in small cups.
items.guidance: Fennel Almond-Milk Warmer is a mild warm beverage rather than a medicinal preparation. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
